# hg backup

**What this page tells you:** every `hg backup` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

App-owned backup routines: list, run, verify, export, restore.

## Synopsis

```text
hg backup list [flags]
hg backup run [flags]
hg backup verify [flags]
hg backup export [flags]
hg backup restore [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

App-owned backup ROUTINES (CronJobs labelled `hermes.dev/backup-routine`), platform-owned invocation. A routine whose artifact is NOT a volume tarball declares `hermes.dev/backup-restore-hook` (JSON: workload, container, command, stagePath, quiesce) and needs `--allow-restore-hook`, since the command comes from the cluster. A routine with neither is reported unrestorable, never restored wrongly.

## `hg backup list`

```text
hg backup list [flags]
```

Routines with staleness.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--routine` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one routine. |

## `hg backup run`

```text
hg backup run [flags]
```

Trigger a routine now.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--routine` | `<name>` | — | The routine to trigger. |
| `--verify` | — | — | Verify the produced artifact after the run. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `180` | How long to wait for the job. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg backup list
hg backup run --profile manager --routine postiz-db --verify
```

| `--routine` | `<name>` | — | The routine whose artifact to verify. |

## `hg backup export`

```text
hg backup export [flags]
```

Copy the newest artifact off-cluster (checksummed).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--routine` | `<name>` | — | The routine to export. |
| `--to` | `<dir>` | — | Destination directory. |

## `hg backup restore`

```text
hg backup restore [flags]
```

Quiesce the writer, wipe the data pvc, untar the archive, resume.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--routine` | `<name>` | — | The routine to restore. |
| `--from` | `<archive.tar.gz>` | — | Restore from a local archive instead of the newest artifact. |
| `--allow-restore-hook` | — | — | Permit a cluster-declared restore hook to run. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `180` | How long to wait for each step. |
